Order 
Appellant has been convicted for offence under Sections 363, 366, 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced 7 years RI with fine of Rs.1,000/-, 10 years RI with fine of Rs.1,000/- and 10 years RI with fine of Rs.1,000/- with usual default stipulation.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
As per status report dated 30.10.2025 submitted by the office of Superintendent of Central Jail,
Vidisha, appellant Santosh has served total jail sentence of 7 years, 7 months and 19 days and he has been given benefit of remission for a period of 2 years and 28 days and, accordingly, he has been discharged from the jail on 23.08.2023.
The appellant has served entire jail sentence with remission period and also deposited the fine amount, therefore, nothing is remained in this matter.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:28161 2 CRA-249-2019 Accordingly, this criminal appeal is dismissed being rendered infructuous.
Let record of the Trial Court be returned with copy of this order.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE Abhi Santosh Ahirwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198349511/
